text: APPROVE: the extracted `IsShebang` helper takes the `&&` chain out of `CommentStart`, and the inner `if` (+1 plus nesting) becomes a ternary of the same cost, so the complexity drops from 16 to 15, which is at the threshold. Behaviour is identical (`-1` for a `#!` shebang, otherwise `i`), and the helper's signature and usage look build-safe under warnings-as-errors. I haven't built or run it here.
